input.answer: The job vacancy rate for Canada in August 2026 was 2.9%, meaning about 2.9% of payroll job positions were unfilled. This is the unadjusted series from Statistics Canada table 14-10-0371 (vector 1212389365). For context, the rate was 2.8% in July 2026 and 2.9% in June 2026. The August figure is 0.0 percentage points above July (2.9 − 2.8 = 0.1 pp up, so 0.1 pp higher) and unchanged from June. Values are published as-is with no suppression.
